name: veriara
description: Query the databases and folders your Veriara role can reach: metric_run, report_run, schema_search, db_query, db_schema and the file and document tools, through the Veriara agent API. In a terminal it reads your Veriara session token (or, during the development phase, the organization's API key) from VERIARA_API_KEY.

interface.shortDescription: Query your Veriara databases and folders
